workflow: AI is a type of technology that enables machines to replicate human functions such as interpreting visual material, recognizing speech, making decisions and translating between languages. It has become a key component in many aspects of our daily lives, from healthcare to autonomous vehicles. AI has the potential to improve our lifestyle by helping us automate and optimize various tasks, as well as offer fast and accurate insights into complex and dynamic systems.
